business_problem: CCTV News needed a more accessible way to deliver live and recorded media to hearing-impaired audiences, because human sign-language resources are scarce and conventional media experiences leave many people unable to follow fast-moving broadcast content.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud Xiling and CCTV News built an AI sign-language anchor that translates mainstream media content into synchronized sign-language performance for hearing-impaired audiences. The solution breaks the problem into three layers: speech must first be recognized accurately, Chinese text must then be translated into sign-language code with the right grammar and keyword structure, and finally a digital human must express the result through coordinated hand movement, mouth shape, and body language. Baidu's speech-recognition model provides the first layer, while a sign-language translation workflow was trained with extensive annotation support from deaf teachers and students at Tianjin University of Technology. On the expression layer, visual-recognition and motion-generation technology drive a 3D digital human to perform sign language with high fidelity, including precise mouth-shape generation. The same Xiling platform later expanded into a broader one-stop digital-human infrastructure, but its sign-language anchor already proved that accessibility-focused AI media can operate at broadcast scale.

solution_components.name: Baidu AI Cloud Xiling
solution_components.role: Provides the digital-human platform and AI infrastructure used to build and run the sign-language anchor.

solution_components.name: AI Sign Language Anchor
solution_components.role: Delivers synchronized sign-language interpretation for live broadcasts, news, and event coverage.

solution_components.name: AI Sign Language Platform
solution_components.role: Extends the same accessibility technology into text, video, and live scenarios across institutions such as hospitals, stations, and banks.

data_flow: Broadcast speech is transcribed by ASR, converted from Chinese text into sign-language codes through a specialized translation engine trained with deaf-community annotations, then rendered by a digital human whose motion, mouth shape, and expression are generated for synchronized viewing by hearing-impaired audiences.
business_outcome: CCTV News expanded media accessibility for hearing-impaired audiences, proved that sign-language digital humans can work at broadcast scale, and created a reusable platform for broader accessible public-service scenarios.
architecture_clues: The accessibility pipeline is explicitly layered into speech recognition, sign-language-code translation, and digital-human expression generation.
The translation layer required annotation help from nearly 20 deaf schools and 500-600 students.
The solution later grew into a platformized digital-human product rather than staying a one-off event demo.
evidence_quotes: Baidu AI Cloud Xiling's AI sign-language anchor has already provided sign-language services for live broadcasts and sporting events to 27 million hearing-impaired users. (original: 百度智能云曦灵打造的AI手语主播，已经为2700万听障用户提供直播及赛事的手语服务。)

CCTV News and Baidu AI Cloud jointly launched the first AI sign-language anchor, which later broadcast more than 200 news items and several live streams with over 100 million total views. (original: 由央视新闻与百度智能云曦灵联合打造的首个AI手语主播正式上线。...她已经播报了超过200条的新闻资讯，进行了数场直播，总观看次数超过1亿次。)

The project decomposed the problem into hearing clearly, translating correctly, and expressing clearly through a digital human. (original: 首先是最底层，需把健听人说的语音翻译成汉语文本；其次是中层，需将汉语文本通过翻译引擎转换为手语码；最后是上层，通过数字人的动作融合算法，将手语码转换为手语。)
Baidu's ASR accuracy exceeded 98%, while sign-language comprehensibility surpassed 85% after six rounds of iteration. (original: 百度智能云研发的ASR语音识别模型，准确性达到98%以上。...经过6次迭代，相关手语可懂度达到85%以上。)
Mouth-shape generation accuracy exceeded 98.5%, and the same platform later supported broader sign-language and digital-human deployments. (original: 手语口型生成的准确度就超过98.5%。...百度智能云还相继推出了AI手语平台及一体机。)
